newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish pulp derivatives launch delayed to Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: Finnish pulp derivatives launch delayed to Sept 23.

text.p: The start of trade in pulp derivatives has been delayed to September 23, Suomen Optiporssi (SOP), a Finnish options exchange which plans to launch the products said in a statement on Monday.
It was originally planned to launch on September 9.
The finance ministry last Friday approved regulation governing trade in the new pulp derivatives, SOP said.
"The start of trade is being postponed to Monday September 23 ... so that the rules and product specifications can be brought to the attention of all market partners," it said.
